items.title: Sling ropes in $123m for oral thyroid eye disease drug
items.summary: Sling is racing to market the first oral IGF-1R blocker, which would likely provide competition to Amgen’s Tepezza.

items.title: Looking beyond short-term turmoil, Syngene is investing for the future
items.summary: CRDMO Syngene has revamped its leadership and is building capacity as it eyes growth and emerging modalities.

items.title: ERS 2026: obesity, an independent obstruction to biologic-treated asthma
items.summary: At ERS 2026, investigators presented their findings exploring the link between BMI and severe asthma outcomes in response to biologics.

items.title: Gilead and PAHO agree to expedite lenacapavir access for HIV prevention
items.summary: Gilead Sciences and the PAHO have signed an agreement to expedite access to the company’s twice-yearly lenacapavir injection for HIV prevention as PrEP across Latin America and the Caribbean.

items.title: Eli Lilly and QurCan sign genetic medicine deal
items.summary: Lilly and QurCan Therapeutics have partnered to develop genetic medicine for diseases of the central and peripheral nervous systems.
